title: Kissed Citrusy Korean Farfalle Anju Pasta
description: A citrusy and snappy Korean-inspired vegetarian dish featuring farfalle pasta, perfect for a fun and adventurous meal. This anju-style pasta is broiled to perfection and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the farfalle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gochujang sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, grated ginger, toasted sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked farfalle pasta to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the pasta to a baking dish and broil for 5 minutes, or until slightly caramelized.
Remove the pasta from the oven and garnish with chopped green onions.
Consider serving with additional gochujang sauce on the side for added flavor.
This dish is perfect for a fun and adventurous meal with friends and family.
